name: nixhm-sudo-oci-analytics
description: Home Manager system image for oci-analytics (Matomo, Umami, Dozzle)

public_ports.desc: HTTPS (public ingress — caddy-public layer4 SNI mux: mail→maddy, public→L7, rest→gcp-proxy)
WireGuard wg-public hub — handshake ingress (open enrollment mesh)
public_ports._doc: Should be auto-derived by engine from wireguard_public.hub == this VM's alias AND wireguard_public.port. Until that engine refactor, declared explicitly here so the hub actually receives WG handshakes.

protection._doc: Per-VM overrides for the protection stack; merged over native.protection defaults (config.json). THE FLEET'S ONLY PUBLIC EDGE — tier-1 is the edge data path itself: caddy-public terminates TLS, unbound-dns64 resolves for it, cf-worker-http-to-wg-public-bridge carries inbound off-mesh traffic, c3-public-api is the public API. Analytics (umami, umami-db) is the sheddable demand. Empty tier1 here made shed_non_tier1() return 1 and escalate straight to `systemctl stop docker` — that amputated the public edge twice in 24h (2026-09-05 ~70min, 2026-09-06 seven hours).
